title: Two Bins at Jazz on the Green: Innocent's Vote on Quitting
conflicts: Pinto's investment: £230,000 per Balon (MoneyWeek 2006) vs £250,000 per the Guardian 2009 and Irish Times 2008; both given with attribution. Resignation: next day (company) vs following Monday (Balon); both given. Festival date: September 1998 (Irish Times) vs 'summer' (Balon, Guardian). The Guardian's 2016 interview says Reed quit in 1999, against both founders' accounts; the story follows the founders. A reported coin toss (Inc., blocked) is not used.
notes: Funding set to 'mixed' (self-funded test, then a private investor) rather than the slate's 'bootstrapped'. The company timeline is cited from an Internet Archive copy (2013) over http, because web.archive.org refused https intermittently. Exclamation-marked Balon quote deliberately paraphrased.
